text: Talon UI 是面向 DeepSeek Harness agent 的交互式终端界面插件。它通过 Cordis 插件和 bundle 接入 DSH，在真实 TTY 中呈现流式对话、工具审批与用户提问面板，并提供斜杠命令、模型选择和会话恢复。用户可以在终端继续历史会话、切换工作区会话或创建新会话，也可查看状态并正常退出。适合希望在命令行中完整交互操作 DSH agent 的用户；需要可用的 DSH 主机、终端和宿主配置的模型服务。

Talon UI is a terminal interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness agents. It presents streaming conversations, approval prompts, and user questions in an interactive TTY. Commands show status, select models, resume, or start fresh. Requires a DSH host, terminal, and configured model service.

Talon UI 的功能「交互式对话」：在 TTY 中呈现 agent 對话和流式回复，用户可在终端持续交互。
Talon UI 的功能「审批与提问」：收到当前 agent 的审批或提问请求时，通过面板收集用户决定或答案。
Talon UI 的功能「会话恢复」：通过 /resume 浏览可恢复会话并重新绑定界面，也可用 /clear 开始新会话。
Talon UI 的功能「模型与状态命令」：提供 /model 选择模型，并以 /status 查看当前会话、工作目录和 agent 状态。
Talon UI 的功能「退出」：通过 /exit 或 /quit 结束交互，并在终端输出可用于恢复会话的提示。

talon-ui README · Talon：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/talon-ui)

A terminal UI for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents, shipped as a dsh **plugin bundle**. Talon renders a full interactive session — streaming transcript, tool approvals, user questions, slash commands, and cross-workspace session resume — inside your terminal, on top of an unmodified harness checkout.

> 中文文档见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

talon-ui README · Features：- **Boot banner** — the session opens on dsh's whale in the talon teal, beside the version, the active model and the working directory. It is a transcript cell rather than a fixture, so it scrolls into scrollback as the session grows instead of holding rows forever, and it is the one place the full path is spelled out.
- **Streaming transcript** — role headers with plain, copy-friendly text (drag-select copies exact message text), streamed markdown that settles into cached committed cells, context-injection cards grouped by proximity with the label carrying the emphasis, a blank row between a turn's reasoning and its reply, and zero `ESC[3J` scrollback wipes during normal interaction.
- **A tone hierarchy, not a wall of grey** — the terminal's own foreground for identity, the brand teal for the model, `dim` for reference values, and a threshold tone for context occupancy, which turns warning at 75% and error at 90%. Everything is ANSI-16 with no backgrounds, so it remaps to your terminal theme; the teal gradient is the single exemption, enforced by a snapshot gate.

talon-ui README · Requirements：- Node >= 22.19, pnpm
- A checkout of `deepseek-harness` as a **sibling directory** of this repo
- An interactive terminal (talon fails loud off-TTY; use `dsh --profile headless` for automation)

talon-ui README · Install：Either way, build the harness first (dsh is the host talon runs in):

```bash
cd deepseek-harness && pnpm install && pnpm run build:lib:host
```

talon-ui README · From npm：Talon is published as [`talon-ui`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/talon-ui) — no clone, no build, prebuilt `lib/` ships in the package:

```bash
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile talon add talon-ui
pnpm dsh --profile talon
```

`talon-ui@0.2.1` is verified against the dsh `0.1.2-alpha.1` line.

talon-ui README · From source (development)：Clone this repo as a sibling of `deepseek-harness`, build it, and install the profile with a live symlink:

```bash
cd talon-ui && pnpm install && pnpm build
cd ../deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile talon add link:../talon-ui
```

talon-ui README · From source (development)：`dsh plugin` seeds `$DSH_HOME/profiles/talon` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/talon`) with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` and appends `talon-ui` as a bundle layer. The `link:` protocol installs a real symlink to this repo, so after any source change `pnpm build` is all it takes — no profile reinstall. See [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md) for details, including uninstalling and why `link:` rather than `file:`.

talon-ui README · Usage：```bash
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh --profile talon
```

talon-ui README · Keys：| Key | When | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` | composing | send |
| `Shift+Enter` | composing | newline |
| `Esc` | turn running | interrupt |
| `Ctrl+C` | turn running | interrupt |
| `Ctrl+C` | idle, text in composer | clear composer |
| `Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+D` | idle, empty composer | exit |
| `Ctrl+L` | anytime | force full redraw |

talon-ui README · Panels：- **Approval**: `1` allow once · `2` reject · arrows move the highlight · `Enter` picks it · `Esc` cancel.
- **Question**: `↑`/`↓` or `1`–`9` move · `Space` toggles an option (multi-select) · `Tab` (or `c`) switches to a custom free-form answer · `Enter` submit · `Esc` cancel (from custom mode: back to options) · `PgUp`/`PgDn` page long question headers.
- **Resume**: type to filter · `↑`/`↓` move · `Tab` toggles this-workspace / all-workspaces scope · `Enter` resume · `Esc` clears the filter, then closes.

talon-ui README · Try it：- Streaming: `Explain what this repository does.`
- A question: `Use ask_user_question to ask me a multi-select question with options Alpha, Bravo, Charlie.`
- An approval: `Run exactly: touch ~/talon-demo` — the sandbox denies writes outside the workspace, the model escalates, and the approval panel appears.
- Resume: `/exit`, relaunch, `/resume`, pick the session — the transcript replays and the agent continues where it left off, even from a different working directory.

talon-ui README · Development：```bash
pnpm test        # vitest, v8 coverage, per-file 100% thresholds on src/
pnpm typecheck   # tsc strict against the harness checkout's built declarations
pnpm build       # emits lib/ (what the linked profile actually runs)
pnpm test:e2e    # live PTY smoke: boot → stream → approval escalation → goodbye

talon-ui README · Development：`pnpm test:e2e` drives a real `pnpm dsh --profile talon` session on a PTY against the live model. It needs the built harness, the `link:`-installed talon profile, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, and `python3`; when anything is missing the suite skips itself, and the default `pnpm test` never runs it. The approval phase creates and removes `~/.talon-e2e-<pid>`.
talon-ui README · Development：Design documents live under [docs/](docs/): the design spec in [docs/specs/](docs/specs/) and per-milestone implementation plans in [docs/plans/](docs/plans/).

talon-ui README · Architecture：- **`talon-ui/boot`** (`talon-boot`) — host side: creates the root agent with the composition's default model selection. The UI plugin never owns the agent (dedicated-front-door design).
- **`talon-ui`** — the UI: mounts the controller on a real TTY, renders through [pi-tui](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-tui), and consumes dsh strictly through narrow service facets (approval responder, question provider, command registry, session query, agent registry).
- **`cordis.patch.yml`** — the bundle layer composed on top of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`: storage + session-projection cache (cheap session titles for the resume selector), `dsh-tool-ask-user` (the model-facing question tool), and the two talon rows.

talon-ui README · Architecture：Rendering follows an event-driven, replay-identical discipline: everything the transcript shows comes from durable session events, so a live session and its later resume render the same bytes. Untrusted strings (model text, tool output, titles) pass a sanitizer before styling; committed cells cache their rendered lines and only mutating state invalidates them.

talon-ui README · Status：Milestones T0 (skeleton), T1 (core loop), and T2 (rich interaction: approvals, questions, commands, resume) are complete and covered by unit, snapshot, and live PTY tests. Next up: T3 (rich rendering — markdown highlighting, tool cards, diffs) and T4 (polish — model picker, `@file` completion, notifications, image paste, Windows).
